prompt:
This is a panoramic dental X-ray.
Use the FDI tooth numbering system ONLY (11-18, 21-28, 31-38, 41-48).
Do NOT use Universal numbers 1-32.

Task: find abnormal teeth and list every diagnosis that applies from:
Impacted, Caries, Deep Caries, Periapical Lesion.
One tooth may have more than one diagnosis. If so, write a separate line for each diagnosis on that same FDI.
Only list teeth that clearly show one or more of these abnormalities.
If none, write None.
The Total abnormal line is formatting only and is not used for scoring.

Answer in exactly this format:
Findings:
<FDI>: <diagnosis>
<FDI>: <diagnosis>
Total abnormal: <count>
Confidence: High/Medium/Low

Example:
Findings:
18: Impacted
16: Caries
36: Deep Caries
Total abnormal: 3
Confidence: Medium

run_config.parse_source: Findings FDI lines only; Total abnormal ignored
